set.body: Qualifying current Scaladock main source085740f against Studio candidate03f1162f surfaced a broader UI migration: seven macOS failures in A11yRenderSuite, A11yTreeSuite and ColumnMappingPaneFxSuite. New dock tabs/menu/header buttons enter Tab traversal but Studio derived orders omit them; Compare has duplicate accessible BUTTON names Maximize/Open in new window. Native run39886219566 job120194901018 (raw log archived with restore-fix evidence). Preserve actual keyboard reachability and unambiguous names; do not weaken the assertions or silently add many Tab stops contrary to DESIGN_SPEC15. Review desired dock chrome navigation, board/spec implications and shared focus contracts before adopting full current upstream. Restore bug is fixed separately upstream PR4 and will reach Studio via a narrow628c46f backport. Full current pin adoption remains open.
set.title: Adopt current Scaladock keyboard and accessibility contracts in Studio
